name: HyperMoto
storyline:
The megacity never sleeps, and neither does its underground. After midnight the authorities look away, and the city’s flyovers, tunnels and dirt-strewn service lanes become one illegal circuit: the Grid.

Here, nobody takes the clean line. Supermotard machines tear through asphalt, gravel and wet neon, sliding sideways into corners and carrying every drift into the straight. Sparks are your signature, and a crew’s reputation is written in scorch marks.

You start as an unknown rider with a borrowed bike and a number nobody remembers. Win a race and a district opens. Win a district and its crew has to answer. Each one rides harder, dirtier and faster than the last.

The Grid keeps score, and the top rank is always up for grabs.

Slide in. Light it up. Own the night.
summary:
Back it in. Pin it out.
HyperMoto is a sci-fi supermotard racing game built around one idea: the fastest line is the one you earn. Brake upright, flick the bike in, slide the rear and fire out of the corner, then do it again over dirt, wet tarmac, glass and steel grid.

Nineteen circuits take you from a skyline supermoto ring to a martian ridge, a frozen halo, a jungle nebula, a neon corkscrew tower and a grand finale in a dusk coliseum. Every circuit has its own music, and every lap is timed against your own ghost.
